# model


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

The detector is one graph per input shape, because both sides are fixed
and must be multiples of 32. The recognizer is one graph, 48×320. A
cache directory of compiled MEFs is reused; an empty directory is where
a new compilation is written.

A non-empty cache is loaded. An empty one receives the compiled model.
The directory is the cache key the callers choose, including the
detector’s height and width in the name.

*Compile the detector for one input shape.*

Pass `size` for a square, or `height` and `width` for the rectangle
[`detection_hw`](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/ocr.html#detection_hw)
produces. Both sides must be multiples of 32, which
[`detection_hw`](https://alix559.github.io/solid_lens/ocr.html#detection_hw)
already guarantees.
